136055.overview: Zootto Mahjong! is a Nintendo developed and published Super Famicom video game. It was released on July 1, 1998. It is a simple game of Mahjong, of which there were many that were created by Nintendo. It was the last Mahjong game developed for the Super Famicom, and was also available through Satellaview. In the game you choose which animal you want to play as before the game starts.

179552.overview: Zootto Mahjong (「ＺＯＯっと麻雀」) is a view-limited Downloadable game for the Satellaview that was broadcast in at least 2 different versions in 1998. Zootto Mahjong Preview Ban (「ＺＯＯっと麻雀 プレビュー版」) was a preview version of the game that would eventually be released in hard-copy for the SFC, and Zootto Mahjong Event Version (「ＺＯＯっと麻雀 イベントバージョン」) was a contest event version of the game.
